notes.title: Ship It! A Warehouse Game Update 2
notes.content:
As of writing this I am almost at my first milestone of 100 Wishlists. That alone is the reason why I want to keep going. It might be only 100 to some... but it might as well be 1,000,000. 

<3 Thank you all! <3

Upcoming Changes:

I have gotten the game into a third person game, and have changed the environment to match. 
I have added several things including the vending machine. 
A hard and easy mode dependent on what the player prefers. 

The Hard mode, physics are in play, and the player will need to carefully move the crates around the warehouse. 
In Easy Mode, the player is guided on how and when to pick up the crate, and will be more 'Player' Friendly compared to battling physics. 

Once the modes are in place I will start working on getting the game loop back to playable state. 

List of other things to do:
Upgrades, 
Vending Machine to increase certain buffs, 
Trailer,
Kickstarter, (as I need money to continue working on this full time.)
Minigames, and more! 

My next update will include images!

Please stay tuned and add to your wishlist!
I promise it is worth the wait!  
Thanks, 
-Space Bro

notes.title: Ship It! A Warehouse Game Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Space Bro here, you might be asking yourself what is going on with "Ship It!"?

I am going to start full-time development June 30th. I am going to spend a lot of time updating what "Ship It!: A Warehouse Game" is actually going to be. 

Firstly, I am moving away from the mobile UI, and more toward moving toward a third-person game. The first week of development will focus on this. I am also going to focus majorly on the Game-Loop itself. 

Some other things I plan to work on the first month are the following: 
-Updating To Unity 6. 
-Expanding the factory to include receiving area, and shifting a bit of focus to also include making the crates. (More on this in future updates)
- Major back-end changes.
- AND MORE.

Potential Kickstarter might be in the works too!

When I really start into development, I'll be posting more often with what is going to change. 

Release timeline:
Depending on a few variables I am aiming for before 2026. Potentially sooner. 

Open to suggestions and feedback, and I have a discord open. 

https://discord.gg/bV5ZNcEhuS
